original_finding_content.subject: Trustpilot 5-year seller reports shop paused without explanation
original_finding_content.raw_text:
**What:** Seller with 5 years on Etsy and 4.8/5.0 reviews reports their shop was placed in forced holiday mode with no explanation, and experienced 10+ days of no communication despite daily contact attempts.
**Verbatim snippet:** "I have been on Etsy for about 5 years and my shop is in excellent standing. They haven't given me any explanation why they put my shop into holiday mode, and you're not answering any messages... I have been contacting you for over 10 days now – daily, no response."
**Source:** https://www.trustpilot.com/review/etsy.de
**source_type:** buyer_review
**verification_status:** could_not_verify
**Date:** 2025–2026
**Notes:** Trustpilot review found via Google search snippet. Exact review date not confirmed. 5-year seller, 4.8/5.0 review score, Star Seller. Forced holiday mode. 10+ days no response. Degraded to Part 4 due to imprecise date.
